name: Oceanscape International Limited
summary: Oceanscape International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the commodities trading and renewable energy business in Singapore. It operates through Commodities Trading and Renewable Energy segments. The company offers trade of metal ores, in particular, iron ores essential for renewal energy and electric vehicles; renewable and sustainable energy-generation projects, such as solar power, wind power, and hydroelectricity; and sale of electricity and development of energy storage systems. It also provides photovoltaic, nano battery, and electrical equipment products; and management consultancy services. The company was formerly known as V2Y Corporation Ltd. and changed its name to Oceanscape International Limited in December 2025. Oceanscape International Limited. was founded in 2014 and is based in Singapore.
